description:
Spec: .openspec/specs/station-project-root/spec.md (slug station-project-root), written before this implementation. Implement it in the factory.

Problem: tools/claude_station.py and tools/codex_station.py resolve repo_root from their own file location (parent of the tools folder). When a project wires its runtime through a factory checkout inside the project (python3 .anvil-factory/tools/dispatch_station.py), every station executes inside the factory tree. Evidence: arananet/foryou-lab run 42336853184 (factory issue 34): reviewers read the factory's specs and its stale runs/wo-gh-1 outputs, reported the project spec missing, quoted a builder output that never existed in that project, and wrote review files under .anvil-factory/runs/ where the project runner never looks, so the approver counted 0 of 6 and the verdict was no_reviews.

Build per the spec scenarios: S1 external layout reviewer file lands in the project runs directory and counts; S2 builder edits land in the project tree and the factory tree stays untouched; S3 in-factory layout behaviour unchanged; S4 undeterminable project root fails loudly with no session run; S5 both wrappers resolve the same root. Project root must come from the execution context (packet path, output path, working directory, or an explicit environment value the runner sets), identically in both wrappers, never from the wrapper file location alone. Automated tests in the factory suite cover S1 to S5 and the full suite stays green.

Staged only: this work order is filed with its spec; no run is fired by filing.
title: Station wrappers must resolve the project root from the execution context, not their own file location
